# xoong

xoong is a small web framework on the browser platform. Screens are HTML, the data layer is generated
from OpenAPI, styling is plain CSS. Status: 0.0.x prototype; the HTML syntax is Draft. Light DOM only;
no virtual DOM, JSX, hooks or required build.

## Rules (follow all of them)
1. One way to do each thing. Reads: `<xo-view get>`. Writes: `xo-click` / `xo-submit`. Never call fetch/axios yourself.
2. Never write a cache key, HTTP client, response type or error handler; they come from the OpenAPI document.
3. Style with plain CSS/SCSS (custom properties, `@layer`, `@scope`); no utility classes or CSS-in-JS.
4. Use native elements (`<button>`, `<form>`, `<dialog>`, `<details>`). Buttons need text or `aria-label`.
5. Run `xoong check <html files>` and fix every error; messages contain the fix.
6. Never invent attributes or operations. Allowed `xo-*` attributes are below.

## Project setup
    xoong new my-app --spec openapi.json      # scaffold + first list screen
    xoong sync openapi.json --hints xoong.hints.json   # writes .xoong/operations.json, api.d.ts
    xoong dev                                 # static server + API proxy + .ts stripping (xoong.config.json)
    xoong check index.html                    # lint screens against the API
    xoong doctor openapi.json                 # what in the OpenAPI document limits xoong
    xoong build --out dist                    # strict-CSP static output; xoong i18n extract <files> --out en.json

xoong.config.json: `{ "port": 5173, "proxy": { "/api": "http://localhost:8080" } }`
xoong.hints.json: `{ "idNames": ["id","gid"], "schemas": { "SessionResponse": { "entity": "Session", "id": "session_id" } },
  "unwrap": "data", "idempotencyKeys": { "sendMessage": "client_message_id" } }`
(hints fix the spec: `entity` shares records; `unwrap` reads {code,message,data}; idempotencyKeys: fresh UUID per call;
`fields: { "Schema.prop": { label, hint, placeholder, widget, order, readOnly, hidden, group, emptyAs } }`; `schemas.X.pruneEmpty`.)

## Start-up (src/main.ts, all the JavaScript most apps need)
    import { configure } from '@xoong/data';
    import '@xoong/data/view';
    import operations from '/.xoong/operations.json' with { type: 'json' };
    configure({ api: operations, baseUrl: '/api', streamUrl: '/api/events' });

## Screens: HTML syntax (inside <xo-view>)
    <xo-view get="/users" live>                        read GET /users; `live` applies stream events
      <p xo-if="$loading">Loading…</p>
      <p xo-if="$error">{$error.code}: {$error.detail}</p>
      <tr xo-each="items"> <td>{name}</td> <td><a href="/u/{id}">{email}</a></td>
        <td><button xo-click="POST /users/{id}/disable">Disable</button></td> </tr>
    </xo-view>
    <xo-view><form xo-submit="POST /users"> <input name="name"> <button>Add</button> </form></xo-view>

- `get`: "/path" (GET /path), "GET /path", or an operationId. Path params come from `p-<name>` attributes:
  `<xo-view get="/users/{id}" p-id="42">`; `p-id="?id"` reads ?id= from the page URL. JS: `view.params = { id: 7 }`.
- `{path}` reads a field of the current item (`.` = the item, `a.b` nested), then the view's `p-*` params.
  Variables: `$loading`, `$error` (`status`, `code`, `detail`, `retryAfterS`), `$index`, `$stream`/`$streaming` (event-stream call). Text is escaped;
  `javascript:` URLs become about:blank; `on*`, `srcdoc` cannot be interpolated.
- `xo-each="path"` repeats the element per item (keyed by entity id). `xo-if="path"` / `xo-if="!path"` (empty array = false).
- `xo-click="OP"` calls one; `xo-submit="OP"` on a `<form>` sends its fields as JSON (see Forms; `xo-keep` keeps them). `xo-body="path"`: a click's body from the scope.
  OP = "METHOD /path/{param}" or an operationId; `{param}` comes from the item, then the view's `p-*`.
- `xo-optimistic="status=disabled"` on an xo-click in xo-each applies at once; undone on failure.
- `xo-select` on a row checkbox ticks the row (`all:items`: all); `xo-selected` on an xo-click button runs it per ticked row. `<xo-table selectable>` adds both. `$selectedCount` counts them.
- `xo-confirm="Delete {title}?"` asks first (native dialog; `setConfirm(fn)`). `xo-notice="Saved"` toasts on success. `xo-with="status=published"` adds body fields.
  `xo-selected="ids"` sends ONE request with the ticked ids; `$selected`: ticked rows.
- `<xo-view url-params="status,q,sort,offset">` keeps those params in the page URL. A button with `xo-param="status=draft"` gets `aria-current` while current (`status=`: unset).
- Formats: `{publishedAt | datetime}` (date, time, relative, number, localized, json; `setFormat` adds).
- `xo-param="k=v"` on click sets a view param and refetches (`k+=n`, `k-=n`, `k~=v` toggles). Vars: `$hasPrev`, `$hasNext`.
- Events (bubbling): `xo-done` {detail: result}, `xo-error` {detail: XoongError}. A running call sets `aria-busy`.
- After a mutation, queries whose path overlaps it are refetched (POST /users/1/disable refreshes GET /users and GET /users/1);
  not a detail query whose entity the response returned. Override: `configure({ invalidate: { shipOrder: ['getDashboard'] } })`.

## JavaScript API (only when HTML is not enough)
@xoong/data: `configure(opts)`, `getClient()`, `derived(({ all, get }) => value)`, `createClient(opts)`, `connectStream`.
  opts: api (operations.json), baseUrl, headers (fn -> object: auth), credentials, staleTime=30000, gcTime=300000, retry=2 (GET only),
  evictEntities, retryDelay=300, invalidate, onError, onUnauthorized, streamUrl, fetch.
  TypeScript: `createClient<Operations>(...)` (from .xoong/api.d.ts) checks names, params, bodies.
  client.load(op, params) -> data | client.query(op, params) -> {data, status, error} signals | client.mutate(op, params, body)
  client.stream(op, params, body) -> async iterator of SSE events {event, data, json, id}
  `derived` = computed over loaded entities of a type (`all('Order')`).
@xoong/core: `signal(v)` (.value, .peek()), `computed(fn)`, `effect(fn)` (side effects only), `batch`,
  `untracked`, `html` + `render(result, el)`, `XoElement` + `define(tag, class)`.
  html`<p class=${() => c.value} ?hidden=${() => h.value} .value=${v} @click=${fn}>${() => t.value}</p>`
  class X extends XoElement { static props = { name: String, n: Number, on: Boolean }; render() { return html`...` } }
  define('x-card', X)   // the tag needs a hyphen; form controls extend XoControl

## Forms (`<form xo-submit>` with a request schema)
    <xo-view get="getArticle" p-id=":id"><form xo-submit="updateArticle"><input name="title.en"> <button>Save</button></form></xo-view>
  `name` is a path (`a.b`, `items[0].x`). The view's record fills the fields; type, required, min/max, pattern come from the schema.
  The model validates (novalidate); errors show after blur/submit.
  `$form.dirty|valid|submitting|stale|errors['a.b']|touched[..]|filled[..]`. Arrays/unions: `xo-each="blocks"` over the draft with
  `name="blocks[{$index}].title"`, `xo-add="blocks" xo-with="type=image"`, `xo-remove="blocks[{$index}]"`, `xo-move="blocks[{$index}]:up"`, `xo-drag="blocks[{$index}]"` (row handle), `xo-if="type=image"`. Rules: `form.rules = { slug: (v, { record }) => '' | 'message',
  '*': (record) => ({ path: 'message' }) }` (async ok); `form.serialize = (draft, body) => body`. Invalid submit: cancelable `xo-reveal` {path}, then focus; `xo-invalid`.

## Admin set (@xoong/ui; `import '@xoong/ui'`, `<link rel="stylesheet" href="/@xoong/ui/src/xoong.css">`)
    <xo-view get="/users" live>
      <xo-table columns="name,email:E-mail,created:Created:datetime" sortable filters="name:Search" selectable page-size="25" empty="No users">
        <span slot="status" class="badge">{status}</span>   (slot="column": cell)
        <button xo-click="DELETE /users/{id}">Delete</button>   (other: last cell)
        <button slot="bulk" xo-click="DELETE /users/{id}" xo-selected>Delete ticked</button>
      </xo-table>   (needs query params sort, limit, offset, filter fields; `total` in the response)
    </xo-view>
    <xo-form op="POST /users" submit="Add"></xo-form>
    <xo-dialog id="add"> ...content, e.g. <xo-form> </xo-dialog>  <button xo-open="#add">Add</button>  <button xo-close>Cancel</button>
  <xo-toast></xo-toast> shows errors and xo-notice. Style: xoong.css properties; layout: `<body class="xo-admin">` + header, nav, main.

## Routing (admin apps; `import { router } from '@xoong/ui'`; public pages stay one HTML file each)
    <xo-router base="/admin">
      <template xo-layout="shell"><nav><a href="/users">Users</a></nav><main xo-outlet></main></template>
      <template xo-route="/users/:id" layout="shell" title="User"><xo-view get="getUser" p-id=":id">...</xo-view></template>
      <template xo-route="*">Not found</template>
    </xo-router>
  Links are intercepted; `p-id=":id"` reads a path parameter. JS: `router.navigate('/users/3')`,
  `router.guard((to, from) => ok ? true : '/login')`, `router.beforeNavigate(() => !dirty)` vetoes.
  A dirty form makes the router ask first (`xo-guard="off"`: no). 401: `configure({ onUnauthorized: () => router.navigate('/login') })`.

## Languages (`import '@xoong/i18n'`; flat JSON catalogs, ICU-subset messages)
    <h1 xo-t="home.title">Welcome</h1>   <input xo-t="placeholder:k; aria-label:k2" placeholder="Search" aria-label="Search">
  The written text is the default; in an xo-view `{name}` comes from the scope. `configureI18n({ locale, messages, load })`, `setLocale('vi')`, `t('key', { count })`. `{title | localized}` reads `{en, vi}`. Built-in strings: `xoong.*` keys.

## Controls (`import '@xoong/controls'`)
    <xo-tabs label="Page"><section xo-tab="General">...</section><section xo-tab="SEO" id="seo">...</section></xo-tabs>
    <xo-menu label="Actions"><button xo-menu-trigger>Actions</button><a href="/x">Open</a></xo-menu>
    <xo-combobox name="a" label="Author" multiple creatable><option value="1">Ada</option></xo-combobox>   <xo-tags name="kw"></xo-tags>
    <xo-richtext name="body" media></xo-richtext>   (`@xoong/richtext`: sanitised HTML value; `xo-pick-media` is cancelable, call `e.detail.insert({ src, alt })`)
  Panels stay in the DOM; `xo-reveal` selects the invalid field's tab. Combobox/tags: string, or array with `multiple`;
  `remote` + `xo-search`, or `el.options = [...]`. `xo-tooltip="text"` describes any element (icon buttons need aria-label).

## Live updates (server-sent events)
JSON per message: {type:"patch", entity:"User", id:42, path:"/status", value:"x", version:7} | {type:"upsert", entity, id, value, version} |
{type:"delete", entity, id, version} | {type:"resync"}. `version` must increase per entity.

## Errors
Failures become XoongError (problem+json, `{ error: { code, message, retry_after_s, fields } }`, `{ detail }`).

## Testing (Vitest)
    const api = mockApi(operations, { listUsers: () => [{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }] });
    const screen = await mount('<xo-view get="/users">...</xo-view>', { api });
    await screen.click('button'); await screen.submit('form', { name: 'Cy' }); await screen.push(event);
    expect(screen.texts('li')).toEqual([...]); expect(api.unhandled).toEqual([]);
Mock the network, not the data layer.

## Limits today (tell the user, do not work around them)
Swagger 2.0 is converted by `sync` (basic; use `npx swagger2openapi` for exotic files). No request-time SSR (prerender per URL: `xoong render --url /path`), no WebSocket.
